visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Nighttime scene at Hong Kong Disneyland. The iconic castle is illuminated with vibrant projections and surrounded by a spectacular fireworks display. Drones in the sky form patterns while a large crowd of spectators is visible as dark silhouettes in the foreground, many holding up smartphones to record the event. (2) Daytime parade sequence. A series of themed floats pass through Main Street. The first features Zootopia characters, followed by a large red Baymax float and Toy Story characters like Woody and Buzz on a green car. Crowds line the streets under bright, overcast daylight, with park buildings in the background. (3) Product and food showcase. Close-up shots of intricately designed Disney-themed desserts, including Mickey and Minnie ear cupcakes and blue-themed pastries. Displays of merchandise like t-shirts, plush toys, and collectible figures are shown on shelves with bright indoor studio-style lighting. (4) Live stage performance and ride highlights. Characters like Mickey, Goofy, and Duffy perform on a stage in front of the castle. Transition to various rides: the Frozen boat ride with Elsa, the Toy Story Land parachute drop, and a high-speed roller coaster through a dark cave. (5) Nighttime after-party. Three creators, including two females and one male, are seen holding champagne glasses and cheering. They interact with park characters and ride a carousel at night. The carousel is brightly lit with warm yellow lights, and the creators wear light-up Mickey ears and casual festive clothing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy pop music begins immediately with the sound of fireworks exploding in the background. A male narrator speaks with high pitch variability and a friendly, animated tone, welcoming viewers. The background music features a driving beat with prominent synthesizer and percussion textures, maintaining a festive atmosphere. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a transition to the parade. The BGM remains consistent but layers of crowd cheering and rhythmic clapping are added. The narrator continues at a moderate speech rate, describing the floats. The music has a major tonality and a tempo around 128 BPM. (3) A percussive 'ding' sound effect occurs as food is shown. The narrator's tone remains excited. Background noise is low, suggesting a post-produced mix. The music's intensity stays high, with bright spectral characteristics and clear harmonic structure. (4) A series of loud, high-pitched screams and mechanical whirring sounds from roller coasters trigger several quick phases. The music swells slightly, competing with the incidental noise of the rides. The narrator's voice remains dominant and authoritative, guiding the viewer through the attractions. (5) A 'clink' of glasses and a 'pop' of a bottle opening signal the party segment. The music shifts to a slightly more casual, danceable pop style. The narrator and background voices of the creators are heard laughing and cheering with high arousal and positive valence.
